findings.issue: The zh-CN style guide says 'Ellipsis is …… (two marks)'. The desktop corpus uses …… 111 times and a single … once.

The style guide says 'No space inserted between Chinese text and Latin/digit runs'; the corpus writes «#条消息» 9 times and «# 条» 0 times. «最近 19:36» is also loose: «最近» means 'recent'. The corpus pattern for the last item's time is «最后…于{time}» (e.g. «最后回复于{time}»).

findings.issue: A half-width spaced em dash inside Chinese text; full-width «——» is mainland convention. The corpus is mixed (6 « — », 7 «——»). Also applies to dismiss.receipt.answered_in_chat.
